whyItMatters: The Dart toolchain resolves these names against pub.dev, so a name that only looks like the intended package brings foreign code into the app. The name this rule expects is `path_provider`.
actions: Confirm the intended name against the package documentation the project already trusts and pin the declaration to that exact name; a name that is one edit away from a widely used package is a typo until the project can show it published the name itself. If the declaration was meant to be `path_provider`, correct it to that exact spelling.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm pubspec.yaml no longer carries a declared package name in pubspec.yaml within one edit of `path_provider`.
